name: EPIC 231385844
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 8.6 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,268 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.04 solar masses and 8.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,587 K at its surface.
